verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway/AI gateway product focused on runtime traffic management, security, and governance of deployed APIs — the axis of linting API specs (e.g., OpenAPI) against style/governance rules pre-deployment is applicable to an API platform but no evidence shows Kong offering spec-linting capabilities; decK and kongctl are described as lifecycle/config automation tools, not spec linters, and the Dev Portal/Catalog features focus on publishing and cataloging, not rule-based linting.
